name: Water Breathing

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Up to ten willing creatures within 30 feet gain underwater breathing for 24 hours while retaining normal respiration; ritual and exact recipient lifetime.

rules.text: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends.
Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.
